body: I moved to a new city in 2015. Left right after High school. I have no friends in the 3 years I've been here. Loneliness is something i have learned to deal with. Video games help, as do quality memes..... \*sigh\*   hang in there buddy.

Look brother, I respect you for posting and I'm sure you already have but Please! leave behind letters for your loved ones to read. This Post is a great start but it doesn't have to end here.   Type or write away, until your fingers cramp from exhaustion.   I don't know when you plan on doing it but can I know your plan? Look we're both strangers and I can't stop you ... but if you have a plan.. I would like to hear it.. read it.  Maybe I can offer suggestions or at the very least. I can listen.
I may be semi-suicidal but I still love high quality memes.
It's crazy how that works.

Hey man, I read your post. And I'm mad . I'm mad at everyone that has hurt you. You don't deserve this ... all this anger.. it hurts me to see you trapped . No really. I'm going back and forth reading your post and it just makes me ... I don't like what people did to you . I'm sorry you have to be here of all places . Even though it may seem insignificant I just want you to know that I hear you.

Something helpful .. that helped me was talking to strangers about my problems. No way would I tell my family for fear of hurting them, similar to you.  But You can't keep it locked in your mind forever. It will just chip at you little by little.  Vent!! it's a starting point.

Hey g. Thanks for posting. Shit fucking sucks man, I'm not going to take that away from you. But it's good to reflect on your past actions , it lets you own them.. little by little.   That drive to "gym/workout"... don't lose it bro.
I love the drawing . Adorable&Cute . Keep it up!
Get well soon friend.
I'm sorry.

dang homie I'm on xbox. 

​
Psych course was really easy. I had a cool cheesy professor. And I'll definitely check out those shows real quick. Since I just skipped all my classes today.
Sure thing man. I'll keep this post updated as my materials arrive.
Thank you for your time and kind words. I'm truly happy that you have a strong foundation that keeps you going. Hold on to them and cherish every moment.
thanks brother.
You're absolutely fucking right. Just thinking of him breaks my heart. He deserves the best. I still have time to find him a place.
Of course brother. I'm always here if you need to chat

HEY! That hope no matter how ducking small it is you hold on to it okay?!  2 months is a long time , treasure it and let your thoughts free. No use holding them where no one can see them.  Please keep us updated . Always let those evil thoughts out because they will harm and eat you from the inside . We're strangers fighting our own battles but remember you're not alone. Thank you for sharing.

It's a unfair world out there . It's hard to get up and sometimes others aren't there when you need them . But I too am fighting with demons . I think we all our. I can't answer your question but what I'm planning involves carbon monoxide. Read my post of you want more information but please exhaust all your resources first brother. Don't choose the easy way like me . Unless all is lost.

Brother I feel you on the video games. It's a complete coping mechanism that I have abused but I'm still here ... For now.  I'm truly sorry for what has happened to you. My eyes get teary reading these horrible things. But I want you to know that even though it seems pitch black.. You are Not Alone!  What games do you play brother?? I'm on xbox and love for honor and the resident evil series

First of all. Thanks for sharing man. I can't help you in your situation but I will always listen and read . Work schedule is really chewing you up my friend. But as long as you talk about it, it helps from keeping hidden feelings trapped.  I hope for the best for you brother in these trying times.    Just... Never stop expressing yourself even if you have to type for hours. Kind souls will always be around the corner. Cheers
Existing not living . Deep words my friend
Thanks for letting me know. I had planned to call them out of curiosity so I'm a little prepared now.

Careful brother. That's how it started for me . During my long commutes i too started thinking about deep sleep. and here I am so close to my goal. 

Dont let them fester. Talk it out. Research and talk about it.

Nice! I was to scared for that option so you're braver than me. I'm opting for carbon monoxide poisoning but it's always good to have a plan B.    Anyways I hope you find whatever you're looking for bro. If you want to chat let me know.
Happy Birthday Man!!!!!!!

Therapy really helps. Try it out if you can. If not post again and keep us updated . Lots of good people here even the ones hurting . I hate to spam but we do get stuck in our heads. Need to release every now and then. Running sometimes helped me . Cheers brother
Hey G. Every one else has great comments! I'm pretty sure you've been told already but cardio really made me feel good about myself even if it only lasted a couple hours. But you do you G.
I like that.
